subject: Discrete-Time Signals and Systems
topic: Discrete Fourier Analysis: Parameter Lists vs. Structural Primitives
syllabus_context: Unit IV: The Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT). Continuous-time to discrete-time sampling, Nyquist rate, N-point DFT mathematical structure, orthogonal basis functions, synthesis and analysis equations, and FIR filter structures.
declared_learning_objective: State the discrete sampling parameters and frequency resolution equations, formulate the structural matrix definition of the N-point DFT, differentiate scalar parameter rosters from structural basis decompositions, and diagram signal flow graph architectures for discrete-time systems.

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Equations and block diagram architecture rendered on lecture slides.
